## Invitations

This report summarises outreach activity in the River Districts during 2026 Q3. A total of 441 people were invited to participate. Of those invited, 67 attended. The attendance rate was 15.2 per cent. These figures provide a summary of invitations issued and participation recorded during the reporting period. They should be read together when reviewing the reach of the outreach activity and the level of attendance achieved.

## Contact

SMS contact was used to support the invitation process, reaching 376 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 376 invitees. The matching contact totals indicate that the reminder activity covered the same number of invitees as the SMS contact. This provides a clear record of the communications issued in support of attendance and complements the invitation and attendance figures above.

Prepared by G. Evans.
